name: Corona en la Sombra
source:
Sara, an ordinary girl who created a game called "La reina de las rosas de colores", wakes up—just a day before its release—in the body of Ophelia Ravenshade, the villainess destined to lose in a world of intrigue, crowns, and lethal romances.
The Royal Academy of Ávalon becomes her battlefield: there, she must face her cousin Celestine Goldhart, the favorite for the throne, and earn the respect of nobles, heirs, and the king himself.

But on this chessboard, there are three roses that will shape her destiny:

The White Rose (Lucien 🤍): nobility and purity.

The Blue Rose (Adrien 💙): pride and discipline.

The Red Rose (Damien ❤️): passion and danger.

And if she chooses to defy the rules... there is even a forbidden pact: the Harem Route.

Her mission will be to survive as a villainess... or to rewrite destiny and become queen?

[Edited and translated from [url=https://jenifer5.itch.io/corona-en-la-sombra]Itch.io[/url]]
